title: ctenitis apiciflora
intro: Ctenitis apiciflora, commonly known as the Apiciflora Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis apiciflora include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
